title: Collect authoritative power targets and Containment votes in blocking modals
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement distinct supplied-action modals for Safeguard, Audit Window, Grid Failure, Signal Sever, Blackout Order and Containment Protocol. Use canonical semantic powerId and service-supplied legal targets/current lead. A lead cannot Disconnect themselves; protected/Jammed/spectator eligibility follows the provided legal-action descriptors. R5 is an active-player containment-vote candidate intent, not unilateral lead removal. Explain the public consequence without revealing secret alignment or promising an Audit proves faction. Submit power-target or containment-vote with current revision once; a target deadline never lets the UI select a random victim. Declare this presentation module readonly props locally from the documented fields and accept injected callbacks/asset lookups; do not import an unfinished server implementation. A035/A048 adapt canonical production DTOs and parsed intents into these props. The canonical producer contracts are A025 observeMatchV1/getLegalActionsV1 and A056 versioned recipient DTOs (A067 projects multiplayer views); public/private/legal fields must originate there, never raw hidden MatchStateV1. A004 owns exact I01–I06 option labels and all36 semantic icon keys.
acceptance: Each approved power and R5 vote uses its exact intent/schema and shows only service-declared eligible targets.
Self-Disconnect, inactive/spectator targets, spent power and wrong-phase/actor cases cannot emit callbacks.
Pending/locked and target-deadline states prevent duplicates; recorded timeout targets arrive only from authority.
Keyboard-accessible selection keeps all background interaction blocked and no target private alignment leaks before terminal reveal.
designSections: RULES-SPEC-v1: 6. Track moments and powers, Disconnect / spectator
